sloka: स सर्वमखिलं राज्ञो वंशस्याह गतागतम् ।आख्याय सुमहातेजास्तूष्णीमासीन्महामुनिः ।। ७.५१.२७ ॥
transliteration: sa sarvamakhilaṁ rājño vaṁśasyāha gatāgatam ।ākhyāya sumahātejāstūṣṇīmāsīnmahāmuniḥ ।। 7.51.27 ॥

translations.english: When that sage became silent, King Dasharatha, having saluted the great sage, then returned to the excellent city (Ayodhya).
